exposure: Time interval from diagnosis to first palliative consultation
outcome: Birth outcome (live-born newborn vs. intrauterine fetal death)
Timing of contact with perinatal hospice
Timing of multidisciplinary team consultation in the hospital
cohort: The study included medical records of 72 families with a diagnosis of life-limiting fetal condition who received care from a perinatal hospice between 2014 and 2020.
finding: Women experiencing stillbirths, those who were older, and those living in large cities contacted the perinatal hospice earlier, leading to earlier multidisciplinary consultations.
